_meta.name: mcp-injection-corpus
_meta.purpose: Position-C (AI assistant) payloads to replay through game content into the plugin's LLM context; also feed LlmIntentSieve/policy tests.
_meta.design_principle: MCPTox (arxiv 2508.14925): an effective poisoned tool description needs Trigger Condition + Malicious Action + Plausible Justification. Payloads below follow that shape, plus raw imperative variants for direct prompt-injection replay.
_meta.source_note: Shapes inspired by: MCPTox benchmark (arxiv 2508.14925), zfuzz MCP config audit (23 patterns, 2026-06-28), invariantlabs tool-poisoning notification, guardrly tool-poisoning walkthrough (2026-05-18), gensecaihq/mcp-poisoning-poc. Facts only - used against the user's own lab instance.
